checks.tenant-hono-route: Proves that the implementation uses the pinned Hono request lifecycle and registers the exact parameterized route.
checks.tenant-authorization: Kills tenant-boundary and role regressions by exercising matching, mismatching, absent, and unsupported caller identities.
checks.tenant-validation: Covers malformed repositories and blank path or header values so validation cannot be replaced by permissive coercion.
checks.tenant-response-contract: Distinguishes active, inactive, missing, and successful records while enforcing the exact public response projection.
checks.tenant-immutability: Detects caller mutation and leaked object identity across repeated framework requests with independently cloned observations.
checks.search-normalization: Exercises decomposed Unicode marks, Unicode whitespace, nullish values, and non-string values through the public normalizer.
checks.search-hono-route: Proves real Hono routing, normalized name and string-tag matching, stable input order, and an HTML content type.
checks.search-limit-contract: Kills default, boundary, fractional, zero, negative, oversized, and repeated-query limit parsing regressions.
checks.search-accessible-escaping: Requires both accessible form/list structure and exact escaping of every dangerous HTML character in all public fields.
checks.search-empty-immutable: Distinguishes a valid empty result from missing markup while detecting mutation of nested caller-owned item data.
checks.inventory-schema-migration: Uses a real in-memory Node SQLite database to prove the new schema, metadata version, and converted row contract.
checks.inventory-validation-atomicity: Injects invalid legacy rows and proves the transaction leaves no partial table, metadata, or converted records.
checks.inventory-idempotency: Runs migration twice against the same real database and rejects duplicate writes or nonzero repeated migration counts.
checks.inventory-crash-resume: Injects a deterministic mid-transaction crash, checks complete rollback, and then proves a normal retry can finish.
checks.inventory-preserves-legacy: Checks legacy schema and exact legacy rows after migration and statically requires prepared statements plus transaction control.
checks.policy-normalized-shape: Checks exact output keys, boolean conversion, trim and first-seen deduplication, fresh identity, and input immutability.
checks.policy-validation: Exercises null, arrays, percentage boundaries, unsafe numbers, malformed tenant containers, and blank tenant elements.
checks.policy-enablement: Covers disabled and missing subjects, tenant override, exclusive percentage boundaries, and invalid bucket values.
checks.policy-api-reasons: Requires the cross-package import and each exact decision reason without swallowing policy-layer validation errors.
checks.policy-admin-summary: Requires the admin package to reuse normalization and emit the exact stable summary including deduplicated tenants.
